adjudication.rationale: In the newly added `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the code unconditionally does `var comments = document.getElementById('discourse-comments')` and then `comments.appendChild(iframe);` with no null-check, so a host page missing that element will throw a TypeError. It also directly references `discourseUrl` / `discourseEmbedUrl` (declared only via comments `/* global ... */`), so if those globals are not defined on the host page the script will throw a ReferenceError (or produce an invalid `iframe.src` if they exist but are falsy). This is a concrete runtime failure exposed by the diff.
